reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Qambar/color-contrast-checker (https://github.com/Qambar/color-contrast-checker).
Technology stack: javascript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 仓库标题下方直接标着 forked from bbc/color-contrast-checker。README 说对比公式 L1/L2 来自 ISO-9241-3 与 ANSI-HFES-100-1988，并列出三条 W3C 参考链接，还支持 #FFF、#000 这种简写色值；Usage 一段给的是 var ccc = new ColorContrastChecker(); 之后调 ccc.isLevelAA(color1, color2)，Installation 里给出 npm install color-contrast-checker，也给了以 devDependencies 方式写到 2.1.0 的写法。右侧 About 是 An accessibility checker tool for validating the color contrast based on WCAG 2.0 and WCAG 2.1 standards；仓库 5 star、42 个 commit、1 个 fork。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
